During the trial, Pericles skillfully maneuvered the proceedings to highlight the oligarchs' alleged crimes, swaying public opinion in favor of democracy. The trial culminated in the execution of Phrynagorus and some of his followers, as well as the execution of several other oligarchs.

The Trial of the Aristocrats had significant implications for Athenian society.
